scope: two untouched synthetic requests; no optimizer tuning

request.raw: Synthetic instrument calibration. Given a finite numeric input x in [-95,207], return the numeric calibrated index y = (-0.875) * x + (-32), in index-units. Absolute error tolerance is 1e-9 index-units. Input x is required. Refuse missing, nonfinite or out-of-domain x. This is a complete synthetic arithmetic specification; do not infer additional inputs.

Synthetic routing band. Given a finite numeric score z in [-105,114], return numeric -7 when z < -10; return numeric 11 when z >= -10. The numeric result unit is route-band and tolerance is exactly 0. Input z is required. Refuse missing, nonfinite or out-of-domain z. Boundary equality belongs to the second band. No other facts are required.
